title: Lapse Addition by Days Past the Cure Deadline — Community Rules & Site Care Inspection Table
content:
A lapse addition is made to the repeat-violation charge under Community Rules & Site Care by the calendar days from the notice's cure deadline — the notice being the violation notice most recently served on the plan record — to the date of the most recent cure outcome recorded on the plan record.

| Calendar days from the cure deadline to the most recent cure outcome | Lapse addition |
|---|---|
| more than 14 | $30.00 |
| 4 through 14 | $15.00 |
| fewer than 4 | none |

## Both sides of each threshold

| Days | Lapse addition |
|---|---|
| 3 | none |
| 4 | $15.00 |
| 14 | $15.00 |
| 15 | $30.00 |

An outcome dated on or before the cure deadline counts zero days or fewer and carries no lapse addition.

## Hypothetical cases

- Cure deadline 10 June, most recent cure outcome recorded 16 June: 6 days, $15.00.
- Cure deadline 10 June, most recent cure outcome recorded 30 June: 20 days, $30.00.
